description: Every ad account of this business that Taseli runs: Google Ads, Meta and TikTok, each with its id, platform, currency, goal and target, monthly budget and spend so far, totals over the last 28 complete days (the app's window), when it last synced and whether it is read only (nothing changes in it, even approved).
name: list_accounts

externalId.description: The platform's own id, as the platform shows it.

id.description: Taseli's id for the account; the `account` argument takes it or the name.

last28.description: The last 28 complete days, ending yesterday (the window every Taseli screen shows).

readOnly.description: Nothing changes in it, even when approved.

anyOf.description: The `cursor` value for the next page; null at the end.

note.description: A plain note instead of data (nothing connected yet, not available here).

total.description: How many there are in all.

title: The ad accounts
